verificationSummary:
Private bounded tail certificates support complete short Thai-run edits and whole final pure Latin-run deletion after an actual Thai consonant. Five of 18 size-256 diagnostic probes are Accepted. This is a subset repair, not complete ordinary applicability, Stage6/Gate2 admission, or UX proof.

A admits the existing non-edge authored-owner profile: complete final Thai run and shard, old <=24/new <=32/replacement <=8 UTF-16; first old/new scalar is a Thai consonant U+0E01..U+0E2E, all scalars have Script=Thai, and the left witness is BOF or an actual ASCII letter. Full old/new provider replay and bounded combined segmentation preserve the outside facts. Authored span edges retain prior behavior. B removes a complete final ASCII-letter run <=24 after an actual Thai consonant and authentic retained grapheme endpoint. ICU 2.2 line.rs:1259-1284 stops contiguous SA dictionary input at either non-SA or EOF. The prior source is not scanned or sent to the provider; retained shard payload copying and boundary checks do occur and are charged. Source/default/origin semantics, authentic atomic receipt/revision, prefix sharing, structural inverse rules and all 92 accepted/attempt/family slots remain intact.

WORK focused native tests passed: independent cold equality, Thai vowels/marks and negative boundaries, 24-to-32 envelope, prior commands/prefix sharing, all 92 accepted/attempt slots under fault and retry, and structural defaults/origins/inverse behavior. The initial full native run had 80 passes and one obsolete B-rejection expectation; its corrected targeted test passed. No clean full native-suite pass is claimed. WORK final npm run check passed 440 files and 3,026 tests, with one artifact-only skip. PLAN independently reviewed source/provider dependencies and actual accounting, reproduced one parameterized actual-WASM test covering four A/B cases, and accepted the clean six-file candidate through Scope Lock. Core main npm run check passed at the same f339c674 commit: 440 files, 3,026 tests passed, one artifact-only skip.

The clean diagnostic accepted Thai append (19/5/10), Thai backspace (13/2/7), Latin committed composition-update (29/6/19), mixed backspace (54/11/33), and mixed committed composition-update (29/6/19); values are source/property/provider UTF-16 work. Remaining: six budget-exhaustion, three uncertified-seam, one uncertified-boundary, and three separate EOF no-op rejections. All 18 independent cold comparisons were Equal against the actual edited or unchanged source. The 90 catalog rows are static descriptions (75 mutations, 15 no-ops); the other 72 rows were not executed. Raw: C:/Users/nekot/.codex/visualizations/2026/09/27/01a0e247-e7cf-7d73-b719-2ff3736241e4/ordinary-tail-applicability-f339c67.json; SHA256 514fa9e4a110306a81134e97eb392ce2cd1b547722de8047466388e418854ea1. Inherited raw conclusion text describes prior scope; use the observed probes and this accepted predicate for current claims.

Long/interior windows, neutral/space/Common/Inherited transitions, bounded cross-piece access and partial-shard repair remain future slices. No-op and lifecycle contracts are designed but not implemented. Full timing is NOT_RUN: all 11,271 obligations and 180 burst rows remain; corpus/generator IDs, caps 512/512/1024 and p95<=8ms/max<=16.7ms/scaling<=1.50 are unchanged. No geometry, Editor, Backend, public/default exports, production binding or map promotion. Unchanged viewing/editing appearance, positions and line breaks, including transient frames, remain mandatory downstream.

freshnessTriggers: Changes to witness alphabets, source/run/shard ownership, provider policy/resources, cancellation or accounting require affected revalidation.
Corpus, generator, harness, oracle or WASM changes invalidate these exact diagnostic results.
Complete ordinary applicability, no-op/lifecycle behavior, timing, geometry and UX require their own implementation and unchanged admission; this subset cannot substitute.
